te: In Slovakia, declared the exhaustion of Europe because of Ukraine

t: Куранты на Спасской башне Кремля остановили на 10 дней для техобслуживания
d: Они «служат» с 1767 года, поэтому периодически требуется что-либо в них подправлять.
te: The clock on the Spasskaya tower of the Kremlin stopped for 10 days for maintenance
de: They have been in use since 1767, so they need to be re-adjusted.

te: Tehran warns Armenia of red lines in Trump route
de: Advisor to the Supreme Leader of Iran Ali Akbar Velayati said that the US presence near the Iranian border remains a particularly sensitive issue.

te: Protesters in France set fire to lyceum and attacked rescuers

te: Eight killed in armed attack in Turkey
de: According to preliminary data of the investigation, the attacker stopped random cars on the highway and opened fire on people inside.

de: Prices have also decreased for a number of vegetables.
